summary.title: What you are requesting
summary.empty: Choose a service to see its details and indicative price here.
summary.errorsTitle: Please fix these fields before sending:

dropoff.label: Drop-off place
dropoff.hint: Hotel name, address or the place you want to reach.

flightNumber.label: Flight number
flightNumber.hint: So João can follow delays. For example TP1693.

luggage.label: Luggage
luggage.hint: For example: 2 large suitcases and 1 cabin bag.

notes.label: Notes
notes.hint: Practical details for the trip: places you want to see, child seats, luggage. Mention accessibility needs only if they affect the vehicle. Please do not include sensitive health details.

phone.label: Phone or WhatsApp number
phone.hint: Include the country code, for example +44 7700 900123.

Booking.capacityHint: One vehicle seats up to {count} passengers. If you are more, say so in the notes.
Booking.capacityOver: You are more than {count} people. Say so in the notes and João will suggest options.
Booking.consent: I agree that João Vargas Tours uses these details to answer my request and sends it to João by email and WhatsApp (service providers that process it for us), as explained in the <link>privacy policy</link>.

errors.invalid: Check this value and try again.
errors.too_early: Choose a date from tomorrow onwards.
errors.too_far: That date is too far ahead. Choose an earlier one.
errors.unknown_service: Choose a service from the list.
errors.consent_required: Tick the box to send your request.
errors.generic: Check this field and try again.

time.invalid: Enter a valid time, for example 09:30.

adults.too_large: Enter {max} adults at most. For a bigger group, say so in the notes.

children.invalid: Enter a valid number of children.

infants.invalid: Enter a valid number of infants.

dropoff.required: Enter where João should drop you off.

email.invalid: Enter a valid email address, like name@example.com.

phone.invalid: Enter a phone number with the country code, like +44 7700 900123.

consent.consent_required: Tick the box to agree before sending your request.

notice.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
notice.forbidden: We could not accept this request. Reload the page and try again, or message João on WhatsApp.
notice.network: We could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again. Your details are still here.
notice.error: Something went wrong on our side. Try again in a moment, or message João on WhatsApp.
notice.deliveryFailed: Sorry, your request did not reach João. Please send it on WhatsApp instead. We have prepared the message for you.
notice.whatsappAria: Send your request to João on WhatsApp
notice.whatsappMessage: Hello João, I tried to send a booking request on your website but it failed. Service: {service}. Date: {date}. Passengers: {passengers}. Name: {name}.

thanks.notConfirmed: This is a request, not a confirmed booking.
thanks.next: João will check availability and reply by WhatsApp or email.
thanks.whatsappAria: Message João on WhatsApp about your request
thanks.whatsappMessage: Hello João, I sent a booking request on your website. My reference is {ref}.
